messages:
incident-bot: PAGER - p99 latency > 1.2s for POST /v1/generate in us-west-2 (start 1788888800). Alert: sustained 5m.

jordan (oncall): on it, paging into #incidents. checking deploys and recent rollouts.

maya (eng-runtime): I just saw a wave rollout completed ~1788888600: wave-2026.03.17-542. Prefetch/kv flags toggled in that wave.

sam (sre): seeing increased kernel_fallback_count on inference hosts in us-west-2, kernel selection moved to fallback kernels ~1788888755. throughput down ~35%, micro-batching spiky.

jordan (oncall): confirming customer-facing errors? tina, any CS hits?

tina (support): yes, support ticket #INC-9873 from AcmeApps reporting timeouts and 504s for autocomplete. They reported degradation starting ~12:15 PDT.

lee (product): rough customer impact estimate? are embeddings affected or just text gen?

maya (eng-runtime): only text generation path (/v1/generate) shows the fallback path; embeddings unaffected. root cause looks like a kernel selector mismatch when sequence-length distribution hit a corner case in the new quant path.

jordan (oncall): can we apply a quick mitigation? options: rollback wave, flip feature flag to force legacy kernel selection, or enable a kill-switch to divert traffic to dedicated pool. Preference for fastest with least customer impact.

maya (eng-runtime): fastest is flip the kernel-select feature flag back to legacy. Command through FF service:
```
# prod flags
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"kernel_selector_v2","env":"prod","value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'
```
I'll stand by to validate.

jordan (oncall): proceeding to flip via UI now, will post confirmation.

jordan (oncall): flipped `kernel_selector_v2=false` at 1788888920 :thumbsup:

devops-bot: feature-flag-change recorded: kernel_selector_v2=false by jordan at 1788888920.

sam (sre): telemetry: kernel_fallback_count trending down; batching variance still high, but p95/p99 improving. baseline p99 1300ms -> 620ms within 2m after flip.

maya (eng-runtime): still seeing a small subset of hosts in fallback; I'm pushing a hotfix to the selector heuristics (non-disruptive). If that stabilizes, we avoid full rollback.

tina (support): notified AcmeApps, they'll monitor. They reported partial recovery already.

lee (product): good. Can we get a short blameless summary for customer comms? Key points: bad selector in new kernel path after rollout; temporary flag flip restored performance; follow-up rollforward with hotfix tomorrow.

jordan (oncall): creating incident ticket with timeline and mitigation steps. Marking P1->P2 as customer impact limited to a handful of accounts but short-lived.

maya (eng-runtime): pushing hotfix now (build 543). small change to sequence-length bucket mapping. ETA ~10m.

devops-bot: deploy started: wave-2026.03.17-543 at 1788889000.

sam (sre): after 543 rollout beginning, seeing batching stabilize, no new kernel fallbacks on updated hosts. p99 ~ 450ms across region.

jordan (oncall): rolling status -> mitigated. Keeping incident open for verification window (30m).

tina (support): follow-up with AcmeApps: they confirm requests are back to normal, will reopen if they see anomalies.

alex (oncall-nx): taking handoff in 40m. Jordan, please add runbook notes and the flag flip command to the ticket before handoff.

jordan (oncall): will do. adding note: "flip kernel_selector_v2=false" + rollback option if needed + rollout 543 rollforward.

lee (product): postmortem owner: maya. timeline and customer note draft in #incident-postmortems.

maya (eng-runtime): assigning myself. I'll include root cause: kernel selector mismatch with new quant heuristics + insufficient canary-sized sequence diversity. Action items: expand canary sequence-length tests, add selector telemetry guard, and automated kill-switch for kernel regressions.

jordan (oncall): last check 1788889222: p99 stable < 500ms, no new 5xx spikes. closing paging but leaving ticket open for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident timeline recorded. If anything new, reactivate paging. :bell:
